name: Credit Card Roll-Down Calculator
meta_title: Credit Card Roll-Down Calculator: Keep Your Payment Fixed
meta_description: See how much sooner your cards are paid off if you keep paying today’s total minimum instead of letting it shrink, rolling each freed amount to the next card.
subtitle: Card minimums shrink as your balances fall. See how much time and interest you save by freezing today’s total payment and rolling the difference, and each paid-off card’s payment, onto the next card.
